rounds.text: Sagittarius lives by the idea that the journey matters more than the destination, curious and mutable like its element, Fire, torn between instinct and a wish to belong. Temperance embodies {b1} itself, blending different ingredients into something greater than their sum. Through experience and study, both Sagittarius and Temperance temper diverse experiences into deeper {b2}, broadening their view of the world along the way.
